description: Newlines around a namespaced call's :: are ignored inside an object for expression
notes: The spec's function call grammar has a single identifier as the function name (FunctionCall = Identifier "(" arguments ")"), and :: is not one of its tokens. hashicorp/hcl accepts names separated by :: and reports them joined with :: as the function name (finishParsingFunctionCall in hclsyntax/parser.go). The Collection Values section says newlines are ignored between the delimiters of "these sequences", which refers to the tuple and object productions. ForExpr is a separate production whose grammar has no Newline, and the spec repeats the newline rule for parentheses, function call arguments and index brackets but never for for expressions. hashicorp/hcl ignores newlines everywhere inside a for expression: finishParsingForExpr in hclsyntax/parser.go calls PushIncludeNewlines(false). The setting stays in effect for the sub-expressions parsed inside the for expression.
